path_length: sum between chronological successive valid history observations, skip padded gaps
topology_resolution: Frozen GI is complete current-valid graph; no edge pruning. Gate features alone count existing incoming edges at current distance<=50m. LocalEncoder retains radius50.
topology_resolution_status: recommended assumption pending optional user clarification
shared_step0: canonical Stage3B and Stage4A; bitwise match; no trained checkpoint
phase_transition: restore own warmup best model+optimizer+RNG; only LR changed; same sampler cursor reset as B/C

scientific_decision.SUPPORTED: Overall D-B upperCI<0; pedestrian lowerCI<=0; moving vehicle or V>5 upperCI<0; P<5 D-C delta<0 and D-B lowerCI<=0; no reliable major class harm
scientific_decision.PARTIAL: Overall CI contains0; moving vehicle or V>5 upperCI<0; P<5 D-C delta<0; P overall D-B lowerCI<=0 and low-motion D-B lowerCI<=0; no reliable major class harm
scientific_decision.NOT SUPPORTED: pedestrian reliable harm OR low-motion recovery delta>=0 OR moving gain absent without overall gain

gate_collapse: over95% current-valid actor observations gate<.05 OR gate>.95
gate_statistics_primary_population: full-horizon supervised actor-window rows; also report partial and all current context observations separately
tiny: complete TRAIN windows; coverage selected/audited using history only; 1000 fixed-scale updates no HP selection; loss falls, bias nonzero, gate differentiation, finite
neutral_audit: CPU real batch single thread; strict1e-6 raw/logit/prob
reload_tolerance_reason: same frozen CUDA scatter protocol; Top1 argmax may flip near-ties; fresh final evaluation authoritative
